mail.description: Mail providers. `read` must be pollable; `send` defaults to `read`.

read.description: Inbound provider (must support polling). imap covers ProtonMail-via-Bridge, Fastmail, etc.

send.description: Outbound provider for replies. Omit to reuse `read`.

updateAddress.description: The inbox/address owners send change requests to.

developerEmail.description: Gets NeedsHuman alerts when a run cannot proceed safely.

labelPrefix.description: Namespace for the state labels (e.g. WebUpdate/InProgress).

id.description: Stable slug; also the sites/<id> directory name.

authorizedSenders.description: Only these From addresses may request changes.

secretWord.description: Must appear in the email body. Defeats simple From spoofing.

repoPath.description: Path to the local clone, relative to the hub root.

netlifySiteName.description: Netlify site name, used to build the deploy-preview URL.

netlifySiteId.description: Netlify site API ID, used to poll deploy state.

replyTo.description: Override where confirmations go (defaults to sender).

assetDirHint.description: Optional: where images live in the repo (e.g. assets/img).
